questions.question: In his prayer, David said that if the LORD stayed silent, he would be like whom?
What did the wicked people in David's prayer do to their neighbors?

answers.text: They spoke peace with malice in their hearts
They lent money and then charged double
They moved the boundary stones at night

questions.question: David said the LORD will tear down wicked people who ignore His works and never rebuild them. True or false?
David asked the LORD to save and bless His people. What else did he ask for them?

answers.text: Shepherd them and carry them forever
Gather them into one great city
Give them rest from every war
